title: Prepare a same-code Bell resource while cancelling arbitrary logical lift ambiguity
statement: Prepare n physical Bell pairs, measure code checks on one half, clean records and apply a canonical syndrome lift inversely on the first half and conjugately on the second. For R_shat^dagger R_s=Q_f L, (L tensor conjugate L)|Phi_Q>=|Phi_Q>, so output is (Q_f tensor conjugate Q_f)|Phi_Q> plus bounded-support physical faults. No branch is rejected or minimum-weight lift computed.
